verses.text: Then the Spirit led Jesus into the wilderness, where the devil would test him.
After fasting forty days and forty nights, hunger hit him.
The tempter came and said, “If you are the Son of God, tell these stones to become bread.”
Jesus replied, “Scripture says, ‘A person doesn’t live on bread alone, but on every word that comes from God’s mouth.’”
Then the devil took him to the holy city and stood him on the highest point of the temple.
He said, “If you are the Son of God, throw yourself down. Scripture says, ‘He will command his angels about you,’ and, ‘They will carry you in their hands so you don’t hit your foot on a stone.’”
Jesus answered, “Scripture also says, ‘Do not test the Lord your God.’”
Again the devil took him to a very high mountain and showed him all the world’s kingdoms and their glory.
He said, “I’ll give you all this if you fall down and worship me.”
Then Jesus said, “Get behind me, Satan! Scripture says, ‘Worship the Lord your God and serve only him.’”
Then the devil left him, and angels came and took care of him. 🕊️
When Jesus heard that John had been arrested, he withdrew to Galilee.
He left Nazareth and went to live in Capernaum, by the sea in the regions of Zebulun and Naphtali.
This fulfilled what God had spoken through Isaiah the prophet:
“Land of Zebulun and land of Naphtali, by the sea, beyond the Jordan—Galilee of the Gentiles:
The people living in darkness have seen a great light; light has dawned on those living in the land and shadow of death.” ✨
From then on, Jesus began preaching: “Repent! Heaven’s Kingdom is near.”
As Jesus walked beside the Sea of Galilee, he saw two brothers—Simon, called Peter, and his brother Andrew—throwing a net into the sea. They were fishermen.
He said to them, “Come follow me, and I’ll turn you into fishers of people.”
Right away they left their nets and followed him.
Going on from there, he saw two more brothers: James, Zebedee’s son, and John his brother. They were in a boat with their father Zebedee, repairing their nets. Jesus called to them.
They immediately left the boat and their father, and followed Jesus.
Jesus went all around Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing every disease and sickness among the people.

News about him spread through all Syria. People brought him everyone who was sick or suffering from different diseases and pains, people with demons, people with seizures, and paralyzed people. He healed them.
Huge crowds followed him from Galilee, the Decapolis, Jerusalem, Judea, and the land across the Jordan.
